Read and write zarr stores

Source: R/io-zarr.R
zarr.Rd

read_zarr() reads a zarr store into an AnnData(), and write_zarr() (also adata$write_zarr()) writes one, following Python anndata 0.13.4 (zarr.py). Stores round trip between R and Python.

Usage

read_zarr(store)

write_zarr(
  adata,
  store,
  chunks = NULL,
  convert_strings_to_categoricals = TRUE,
  consolidate_metadata = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

store

Path of the zarr directory store.

adata

An AnnData().

chunks

The chunk shape of a dense X, one whole number for each dimension (it does not apply to sparse matrices, layers or other Elements), or NULL for the default. A chunk larger than the array is cut to the shape of the array.

convert_strings_to_categoricals

Whether to convert character columns to factors before writing.

consolidate_metadata

Whether to write consolidated metadata, inline in the root zarr.json, after all Elements.

...

Dataset arguments for every array. compressors is NULL for no compression, a name ("zstd", "gzip", "blosc") or a list with a name and the options of that compressor (level for zstd and gzip, cname, clevel and shuffle for blosc), for example list(name = "gzip", level = 5). The default is zstd. Scalars take the same compressor and the null Element is always zstd, as in Python. compressor is accepted as Python's older name for compressors, but scalars ignore it, as in Python. shards is the shard shape, one whole number for each dimension (it applies to arrays of one or more dimensions, and chunks are reduced to divide it), "auto" to choose the shape, or NULL for no sharding. Without it, arrays are sharded when the auto_shard_zarr_v3 setting is TRUE (anndata_settings), except rec-arrays which Python only shards when shards is given. Other arguments raise anndata_invalid_argument_error.

Value

read_zarr() returns an AnnData() and write_zarr() returns NULL invisibly.

Details

read_zarr() reads zarr version 3 stores, sharded or not, with or without consolidated metadata, from a directory store. Version 2 is not yet supported. Zip stores are not supported, unzip them first. Stores in a legacy layout (such as one with raw.X) raise anndata_legacy_format_error.

write_zarr() writes zarr version 3 (sharded by default) and replaces an existing store. To protect other data it refuses a directory that is neither empty nor a zarr group. The version is the zarr_write_format setting (anndata_settings), and version 2 is not yet supported. With convert_strings_to_categoricals, character columns of obs, var and raw$var with fewer distinct values than rows are converted to factors in adata first, in place, as Python does. X and every layer must have at most 2 dimensions. Like Python, a missing raw is written as a null Element.

Examples

adata <- AnnData(matrix(as.numeric(1:6), nrow = 3))
path <- tempfile(fileext = ".zarr")
write_zarr(adata, path)
read_zarr(path)$shape
#> [1] 3 2
